full_details: Mistress Ansell kept the one hawthorn bough and the three pence you would not eat. At the Fields' the grace was long and the carving short. Jacqueline mended two words and said the French was an English dream of French. Field told you the Plutarch is coming off in sheets, let the chronicle stay, and took the comedy to read with the door shut. He was not telling you news when he said the court went to Greenwich. By the cheese the home vowels were back. At the board the uncles kept the breaths they already had, and the foot of the page stayed empty.
one_sentence: After church you carried the comedy under your cloak to Blackfriars and left two mended words on the leaf.
title: Two words mended, and the comedy left for Field to read
